title: SendGridEvent
description: A single SendGrid Event Webhook object describing one delivery-status occurrence (delivered, bounce, open, click, etc.) for one recipient of one send.

email.description: Recipient email address the event applies to.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds, as a string, at which SendGrid recorded the event; see getEventTime() to convert to an Instant.

event.description: SendGrid event type, e.g. delivered, open, click, bounce, dropped, deferred, spamreport, unsubscribe, group_unsubscribe, group_resubscribe.

category.description: Category tag attached to the originating send, if one was set.

sgMessageId.description: SendGrid's message identifier for the originating send, delivered on the wire as sg_message_id; used to correlate this event back to the outreach email that generated it.

smtp-id.description: The smtp-id header of the originating message, if present.

response.description: Raw SMTP response text from the receiving mail server; present on delivered, bounce, and deferred events.

attempt.description: Delivery attempt number, as a string; present on deferred events.

status.description: SMTP status/response code; present on bounce and deferred events.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the event; present on bounce, dropped, and deferred events.

type.description: Bounce classification, e.g. bounce vs blocked; present on bounce events.
